visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a professional-style indoor kitchen with bright overhead lighting, a young man wearing a white apron and a dark t-shirt stands over a black wok filled with bubbling oil. He meticulously uses silver chopsticks and a small metal strainer to dip pork strips into a light-colored batter before placing them carefully into the frying oil. (2) The camera zooms in as the man lifts the fried pork strips out of the oil. The meat appears soggy and lacks a crispy outer layer, causing the man to look visibly concerned and disappointed. The background features stainless steel counters, various kitchen utensils, and industrial cooking equipment typical of a culinary studio. (3) A female instructor, dressed in a black chef's uniform, a white cap, and a protective blue face mask, enters the scene to provide expert intervention. She handles a metal bowl containing fresh batter and demonstrates the correct consistency and dipping motion to the student, while gesturing towards the wok. (4) The student attempts the frying process for a second time, following the teacher's instructions to increase the oil temperature and work more efficiently. The instructor stands closely by, using a large metal skimmer to help remove the pork strips rapidly as they reach a golden-brown color, ensuring they do not overcook. (5) The scene shifts to a tasting session where the successfully fried pork is presented on a silver plate. The main character and another young man use chopsticks to sample the crispy pieces. They both exhibit positive facial expressions, nodding their heads and smiling while chewing, clearly enjoying the improved texture and flavor of the dish.
